text.p: GreenPoint Mortgage Corp, a unit of GreenPoint Financial Corp, said it is targeting Northern California for an expansion of its "no doc" residential mortgage product with the opening of several satellite sales offices.

GreenPoint, which earlier opened an office in San Jose, Calif., said it has now expanded to San Mateo, Alameda, Contra Costa and also to Marin County. Additional offices will be opened in a third stage of the Northern California expansion, a spokesman said.
The "no doc" or "no documentation" product involves a one-page application which does not require personal income, employment or asset information.

The mortgage requires a down payment of at least 25 percent of the purchase price. GreenPoint said it is suitable for people who are self employed, own a business or have a limited or impaired credit industry.
GreenPoint has been expanding the product nationally and is planning to introduce it in Seattle and Atlanta in coming months, the spokesman said.
